translation: Treatment should supplement what is deficient and drain what is in excess, in order to open its pathway and remove the pathogenic factor. Give the Banxia Tang (Pinellia Decoction) one dose; once yin and yang are connected, sleep arrives immediately. The formula uses eight sheng of flowing water from a thousand li away, stirred ten thousand times; take five sheng of its clear portion and boil it, cooking with a reed-wood fire. When it boils, add one sheng of shu mi (glutinous millet) and five ge of processed Banxia (Pinellia); cook slowly until it reduces to one and a half sheng, remove the dregs, and drink one small cup of the juice, three times daily, gradually increasing according to the response.
